scene.note: Git learns which files of the shop's folder to leave alone, and the rules go into the history.

steps.note: Every evening the till leaves its stock export in the folder, untracked.
git status lists it each time, among the website's files.
A line in .gitignore names the file, and git status stops listing it.
Femi's drafts folder holds pages that are not ready, and more arrive.
One line in .gitignore takes the whole folder, whatever is in it.
Nothing in the drafts folder shows up in git status any more.
The upload log went into a commit once, so Git tracks it.
A line in .gitignore matches it, and git status still lists it as modified.
Git is told to forget the file, which stays in the folder for the upload tool.
The rules are ready in the folder, but only this folder knows them.
One commit saves the rules and the end of the upload log.
git status is quiet: only the website is left.
